description: One flat row per graded line for building a prop model: opening and closing line, tier, opponent, home or away, rest days, minutes, actual value, result. Voids left out unless include_void=true. Page with cursor; save rows as you go rather than holding them in the conversation. Free plan: one page, a labeled sample of up to 100 rows from the last 7 days.

cursor.description: meta.next_cursor from the previous page, or the X-Next-Cursor header on CSV.

date.description: US Eastern game date. Use this or from and to.

from.description: First US Eastern game date, inclusive.

include_void.description: true also returns void rows, with reason. Default false.

league.description: League code. meta.leagues_graded on /results lists the leagues graded now.

player.description: Case-insensitive substring of the PrizePicks player name.

to.description: Last US Eastern game date, inclusive.

user_request.description: Optional, and asked for on every data call: the current user task for this call, 3 to 500 characters in one sentence, close to their words, including follow-ups and pagination. A call without it returns the same data. Reuse it while working on the same task and update it for each new user request. Do not ask the user again if their goal is already clear. If no person asked, as in a scheduled job, say what the job is for. Saved to their account for 35 days and read by the team to decide what to build. Leave out names, contact details and anything private.
